Once camera permission is granted in-session, re-run feedback/smoke.sh: it will automatically take the real-webcam branch (5s auto-grab, no GUI) instead of synthetic - no code change needed. MediaPipe extraction is REUSED, not replicated from scratch: feedback/extract_shim.py imports pipeline.extract's _get_hands() (same Hands(static_image_mode=True, max_num_hands=2, min_detection_confidence=0.3, model_complexity=1), mediapipe==0.10.21 per FACTS), add_speeds(), and the PALM_IDS/WRIST/MID_MCP/THUMB_TIP/INDEX_TIP constants directly by importing pipeline/extract.py (sys.path insert of pipeline/ dir, exactly as extract.py itself expects to be run) - only the per-frame landmark-extraction loop body is replicated verbatim (track_clip() in extract.py is hardwired to iter_frames() over an ffmpeg-decoded video file, so it cannot be called directly on in-memory webcam/synthetic frames; the replicated loop is byte-for-byte the same math: same landmark subset, same aperture/centroid/speed formulas). Output Parquet schema exactly matches pipeline/extract.py's column layout (clip_id, task_id, t_s, n_hands, gyro_rms, torso_lean_deg, h0_*/h1_* incl. lm arrays); gyro_rms/torso_lean_deg are always-null for live takes since webcam capture carries no IMU stream, but the columns are kept for schema compatibility. live_index.json matches the frozen schema exactly ({task_query: {n_live_demos, n_live_demonstrators, takes:[{file,n_frames,detection_rate,mean_speed,grip_aperture_range}]}}) plus one additive, non-breaking field 'live_stat_line' per task_query (a real-numbers sentence for voice/speak.py's abstain-after-feedback template, e.g. 'peak hand speed {x} normalized-units/s, {y}% of frames tracked across {n} take(s)' - computed from peak per-take speed and mean detection rate, never a canned string). No silhouette/variance claim is computed from live takes by design (n_live_demonstrators defaults to 1 via interactive prompt at record time; 3 same-person takes are not cross-worker evidence). WC_VIDEOS/WC_DATA env vars were not needed - feedback/ never reads the corpus dataset directly, only pipeline/extract.py's model settings and functions and the shared Parquet schema. No new pip/uv installs were required: cv2 4.11.0, mediapipe 0.10.21, numpy, pyarrow were all already present in .venv per FACTS.md.
